name: PA speaker on stand
placement: A pair flanking the stage or dance floor, aimed at the crowd, with a power cable to each.
modeling: A tripod of three splayed thin metal cylinders, a central pole to about 1.5 m, and on top a black speaker cabinet box (0.36 wide, 0.35 deep, 0.6 high) slightly tilted down, with a grille plate in a darker box on its front face. Size is one 12 in cabinet; a stacked line array tower is two to four cabinets high.
